issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: HarnessRouter Community Edition
products.tagline: Open-source unified interface for agent harnesses
products.summaryZh: 开源智能体框架统一接口
products.descriptionZh: 即插即用的托管代理工具集成于您的产品中：通过一个API在您的基础设施上使用Codex、Claude Code和Hermes，现已基于Apache 2.0开源。无需重建后端即可切换工具。会话、流式传输、文件、工件、取消、故障恢复，均已处理。模型提供商密钥、状态和交付均在您的控制之下。网关、运行器、控制台集成于一个Docker容器中。即用型入门套件应用，激发无限可能。
products.description: Plug-and-play managed agent harnesses in your product: Codex, Claude Code and Hermes through one API on your infrastructure, now open sourced under Apache 2.0. Switch harnesses without rebuilding your backend. Sessions, streaming, files, artifacts, cancellation, failure recovery, all handled. Model provider keys, state, and deliveries under your control. Gateway, Runner, Console in one Docker container. Ready-to-use starter kit apps as inspiration of possibilities.

products.name: Blume
products.tagline: AI-ready, Markdown-first documentation framework
products.summaryZh: AI就绪、以Markdown为先的文档框架
products.descriptionZh: 从纯Markdown生成美观、快速、AI就绪的文档。Blume为你提供搜索、主题、SEO，以及一键部署到Astro和Vite的功能。
products.description: Ship beautiful, fast, AI-ready documentation from plain markdown. Blume gives you search, theming, SEO, and one-command deploys on Astro and Vite.

products.name: Expeditione
products.tagline: The Interactive 3D Encyclopedia
products.summaryZh: 交互式3D百科全书
products.descriptionZh: Expeditione 是一款由单人开发的交互式 3D 百科全书，旨在让学习变得有趣且令人难忘。你不再只是阅读某个主题，而是可以进入手工打造的、可探索的世界，通过互动来发现知识。它直接在浏览器中运行，无需登录、无广告、无追踪，并经过优化以保持极轻量。前三项探险永久免费，并提供免费的教育者资源供课堂使用。
products.description: Created by a single person, Expeditione is an Interactive 3D Encyclopedia built to make learning fun and memorable. Instead of simply reading about a subject, you can enter handcrafted, explorable worlds and discover them through interaction. It runs directly in the browser, with no login, ads, or tracking, and is optimized to stay remarkably lightweight. The first three expeditions are free forever, with free educator resources for classroom use.

products.name: Vidaya
products.tagline: Healthspan score from your wearables, labs, and DNA.
products.summaryZh: 来自你的可穿戴设备、实验室检测和DNA的健康寿命评分。
products.descriptionZh: Vidaya将你的可穿戴数据、实验室检测和日常习惯转化为真实的健康寿命评分和个性化长寿计划。由厌倦了只显示数字却从不告诉你下一步该做什么的仪表盘的创始人们打造。
products.description: Vidaya turns your wearable data, labs, and habits into a real Healthspan score and a personalized longevity plan. Built by founders tired of dashboards that show numbers but never tell you what to actually do next.

products.name: Chert
products.tagline: Vapi for FaceTime: AI video agents in a few lines
products.summaryZh: Vapi for FaceTime：几行代码即可实现AI视频代理
products.descriptionZh: Chert是FaceTime版的Vapi。只需几行代码，即可构建并部署能够接听和拨打FaceTime电话的交互式AI视频代理。部署代理用于远程支持、现场服务、远程医疗接诊、引导式入门，或任何演示比解释更容易的场景。立即试用：现在FaceTime一个代理，给它展示点东西。
products.description: Chert is Vapi for FaceTime. Build and deploy interactive AI video agents that can answer and place FaceTime calls with just a few lines of code. Deploy agents for remote support, field service, telehealth intake, guided onboarding, or anything that's easier to show than explain. Try it live: FaceTime an agent right now and show it something.

products.name: CostLogic
products.tagline: AI-powered construction takeoffs, estimates, and invoices
products.summaryZh: AI驱动的工程量清单、估算与发票
products.descriptionZh: CostLogic是一个施工算量与项目成本核算工作空间，内置名为Onyx的强大代理。Onyx可代您执行操作。上传图纸、检测房间、校准比例、测量数量、将算量转化为估算并发送发票，全部在一个基于浏览器的流程中完成。从蓝图到发票，无需拼接五种不同工具，将数天的工作缩短为数小时或数分钟。
products.description: CostLogic is a construction takeoff and job-costing workspace with a powerful agent called Onyx. Onyx can perform actions on your behalf. Upload plans, detect rooms, calibrate scale, measure quantities, turn takeoffs into estimates, and send invoices, all in one browser-based workflow. Go from blueprint to invoice without stitching together five different tools, and turn days into hours or minutes of work.

products.name: Vaaya
products.tagline: Turn your Github profile into Credit Card for your agents
products.summaryZh: 将你的GitHub个人资料转化为代理的信用卡。
products.descriptionZh: 基于你的GitHub资料构建代理信用评分，并为你的代理提供可支配资金。通过一个MCP即可让代理访问1400多种工具，如Exa、Firecrawl、Fal（媒体生成）、Apollo.io、Browserbase、Modal等。安装Vaaya很简单，只需运行npx @vaaya/mcp install。
products.description: Build your agentic credit score from your github profile credit profile and give your agents money to spend. Enable your agents to access 1400+ tools like Exa, Firecrawl, Fal (media generation), Apollo.io, Browserbase, Modal and a lot more with just one MCP. Installing Vaaya is simple just run npx @vaaya/mcp install

products.name: Mac Developer Bridge
products.tagline: Give ChatGPT a real terminal on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在你的Mac上给ChatGPT一个真正的终端。
products.descriptionZh: 开源MCP桥接器，让ChatGPT操作你的真实Mac：shell、文件、真实PTY会话、后台任务及只读Codex历史。ChatGPT保持推理层，你的Mac作为执行环境。MIT许可，有意不设沙箱。
products.description: Open-source MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT operate your actual Mac: shell, files, real PTY sessions, background jobs, and read-only Codex history. ChatGPT stays the reasoning layer; your Mac stays the execution environment. MIT licensed and intentionally not sandboxed.

products.name: Assetli.app
products.tagline: Personal finance & net worth, wired to your AI
products.summaryZh: 个人财务与净资产，与你的AI无缝连接
products.descriptionZh: 大多数金融应用只是展示一个仪表盘。Assetli则让你的AI也能使用它。通过MCP直接连接Claude或ChatGPT——你的助手能读取你的真实净资产、交易记录和投资组合，并能在你自己的AI聊天中直接更新这些信息（我们不会看到）。除了预算管理，Assetli还能在一个地方追踪股票、加密货币、房地产、车辆和贵重物品，内置FIRE、抵押贷款和租购对比计算器。无需强制关联银行账户——通过CSV/PDF导入，保持掌控。
products.description: Most finance apps just show you a dashboard. Assetli lets your AI use it. Connect directly to Claude or ChatGPT via MCP — your assistant reads your real net worth, transactions and portfolio, and can update them too, right inside your own AI chat (we never see it). Beyond budgeting, Assetli tracks stocks, crypto, real estate, vehicles and valuables in one place, with built-in FIRE, mortgage and rent-vs-buy calculators. No forced bank linking — import via CSV/PDF, stay in control.

products.name: Make it RAIN
products.tagline: Find who may pay before you automate a guess
products.summaryZh: 在自动化猜测之前，先找出谁可能会付款。
products.descriptionZh: Make it RAIN 面向已经发布产品、但仍需了解谁会付费的技术创始人。粘贴产品 URL，即可免费获得一份“首个客户路径”：买家假设、付费痛点、最小付费方案、价格测试、买家压力测试，以及下一步对话。不同于其他泛泛的 GTM 计划或潜在客户列表，它会在进一步外联之前对方案进行压力测试，并利用买家反馈来优化下一步行动。无需信用卡，未经批准不会发送任何内容。
products.description: Make it RAIN is for technical founders who already shipped but still need to learn who may pay. Paste a product URL and get a free First Customer Path: buyer hypothesis, paid pain, smallest paid offer, price test, Buyer Stress Test, and next conversation. Unlike another generic GTM plan or lead list, it stress-tests the offer before more outreach and uses buyer outcomes to improve the next move. No card. Nothing sends without approval.

products.name: Interview Agent by NexI
products.tagline: AI interviews that screen, score, and shortlist talent
products.summaryZh: AI面试：筛选、评分并入围人才
products.descriptionZh: 通过NexI的Interview Agent革新您的招聘流程。AI驱动的自动化面试、智能候选人评估及无缝招聘工作流。由TalentArbor技术提供支持。
products.description: Transform your hiring process with Interview Agent by NexI. AI-powered automated interviews, intelligent candidate evaluation, and seamless recruitment workflow. Powered by TalentArbor technology.

products.name: Yap - Voice Diary
products.tagline: Journaling Made Easy
products.summaryZh: 让日记变得简单
products.descriptionZh: 无需打字的日记。打开应用，聊聊你的一天，就这么简单。应用会整理内容，并记录你的心情、习惯、待办事项，以及你提到的关于朋友和家人的小事。每天还会生成摘要，方便回顾过去。备忘录、转录、笔记全部保存在你的设备上，随时可以导出。
products.description: Journal without typing. Open the app and yap about your day. It's that simple. The app tidies it up and keeps track of your mood, habits, to-dos and the small things you mention about your friends and family. Each day is also summarised, making going back in time easy. Memos, transcripts, notes all local on your device. Export at any time.

products.name: Nthly - 2FA Authenticator
products.tagline: Nthly is a private and secure authenticator.
products.summaryZh: Nthly是一款私密且安全的身份验证器。
products.descriptionZh: Nthly是一款私密、安全的验证器，采用TOTP和HOTP标准生成一次性密码。可用于登录Google、GitHub、银行账户、工作账户及数百种其他服务。无需创建账户，也无需信任第三方服务器。您的密钥仅保存在您的iPhone上。
products.description: Nthly is a private, secure authenticator that generates one-time passwords using the TOTP and HOTP standards. Sign in to Google, GitHub, your bank, work accounts, and hundreds of other services. There are no accounts to create and no third-party servers to trust. Your secrets stay on your iPhone.

products.name: Scaloom
products.tagline: AI-powered Reddit marketing for Google & AI search
products.summaryZh: 基于AI的Reddit营销，助力Google与AI搜索优化
products.descriptionZh: Scaloom 是一个由 AI 驱动的 Reddit 营销平台，帮助创始人建立可信账号，并将 Reddit 转化为搜索获取渠道。 ✅ 预热 Reddit 账号以积累 karma 与信任 ✅ 查找相关 subreddit 和讨论话题 ✅ 生成 AI 回复草稿，需人工批准 ✅ 发现已在 Google 上排名的 Reddit 帖子 ✅ 追踪品牌在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Perplexity 中的可见度 ✅ 发掘 GEO/SEO 内容机会
products.description: Scaloom is an AI-powered Reddit marketing platform that helps founders build trusted accounts and turn Reddit into a search acquisition channel. ✅ Warm up Reddit accounts for karma & trust ✅ Find relevant subreddits and conversations ✅ Draft AI replies with human approval ✅ Find Reddit threads already ranking on Google ✅ Track brand visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude & Perplexity ✅ Discover GEO/SEO content opportunities

products.name: Harbor ATS/CRM
products.tagline: The only ATS/CRM built by actual recruiters.
products.summaryZh: 唯一由实际招聘人员打造的ATS/CRM系统。
products.descriptionZh: 我们是活跃的招聘者，运营着一家小型招聘机构（https://workinbiotech.com/recruit）。我们开发了Harbor ATS/CRM作为内部工具，并经过数年实战检验。我们对现有遗留软件感到不满，它们臃肿、价格过高，且专为大型企业团队设计，而非独立招聘者或小型招聘机构。
products.description: We are active recruiters and run a small recruiting agency (https://workinbiotech.com/recruit). We built Harbor ATS/CRM as an internal tool and battle-tested it for a few years. We were not happy with existing legacy software that is bloated, overpriced, and designed for large corporate teams—not independent recruiters or small recruiting agencies.

products.name: ShouldBuild
products.tagline: Find out what your market wants before you waste months
products.summaryZh: 在浪费数月时间之前，先了解市场需求。
products.descriptionZh: 你可能花了几个月开发，最后却发现没人需要它。ShouldBuild 会读取真实用户在应用商店、Reddit、Hacker News 和开放网络上的抱怨，给你一个“该做”或“不该做”的结论，并附上可点击的引用。保留值得保留的发现，将其转化为概念和待办清单，每周一查看变化：新对手、新抱怨，以及你发布的产品是否减少了相关抱怨。7天免费试用，无需信用卡。
products.description: You can build for months before finding out nobody wanted it. ShouldBuild reads what real users already complain about — across the app stores, Reddit, Hacker News and the open web — and hands you a build / don't-build verdict backed by quotes you can click. Keep the findings worth keeping, turn them into a concept and a backlog, and every Monday see what moved: new rivals, new complaints, and whether what you shipped made its complaint go down. 7-day free trial, no card needed.

products.name: GetAppNiche
products.tagline: 💰 Stop building apps nobody wants. See what any app earns
products.summaryZh: 💰 别再开发没人要的应用了。看看任何应用能赚多少。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数应用创意在黑暗中消亡：数月开发，零验证。GetAppNiche 点亮明灯：💰 覆盖360万+应用的收入与下载量估算，涵盖App Store与Google Play 🔍 像数据库一样探索两大商店：增长、定价模式、分类筛选 🎯 带难度评分的ASO关键词，每日排名追踪 🕵️ 竞争对手广告、开发者及评论投诉 🔌 API + MCP：让Claude或Cursor为你寻找利基市场
products.description: Most app ideas die in the dark: months of building, zero validation. GetAppNiche turns the lights on: 💰 Revenue & download estimates for 3.6M+ apps, App Store + Google Play 🔍 Explore both stores like a database: growth, price model, category filters 🎯 ASO keywords with difficulty scores, daily rank tracking 🕵️ Competitors' ads, creators and review complaints 🔌 API + MCP: ask Claude or Cursor to find niches for you

products.name: Fabbit
products.tagline: All your growth data. One next move.
products.summaryZh: 您的全部增长数据，一步到位。
products.descriptionZh: Fabbit是一个统一增长情报平台（SEO、分析、竞争对手、CRM、网站审计，一站式集成），将分散的数据转化为每日可执行的下一步行动。其核心差异在于：大多数工具“展示数据”，而Fabbit“展示数据并告诉你该怎么做”，且速度很快。
products.description: Fabbit is a unified growth intelligence platform (SEO, analytics, competitors, CRM, site audit, all in one hub) that turns scattered data into a daily actionable next step. Its core differentiator: most tools "show data," Fabbit "shows data and tells you what to do about it," fast.

products.name: AlsonAI Poetry
products.tagline: Turn poetry and spoken word into illustrated books.
products.summaryZh: 将诗歌和口语艺术转化为插画书籍。
products.descriptionZh: AlsonAI现已支持诗歌、口语诗、韵文及不符合传统故事弧线的写作形式。AlsonAI不再将每个想法强行套入叙事框架，而是学会何时不写——尊重分行、重复、节奏和创作者的声音，同时帮助将他们的文字打磨成精美的插图图书。这是一款创意助手，旨在增值而不干扰创作过程。
products.description: AlsonAI now supports poetry, spoken word, rhymes, and writing that doesn’t fit a traditional story arc. Instead of forcing every idea into a narrative, AlsonAI learns when not to write—respecting line breaks, repetition, pacing, and the creator’s voice while helping turn their words into a polished illustrated book. It’s a creative assistant built to add value without getting in the way.

products.name: AirAlarm
products.tagline: Wake at the end of your sleep cycle
products.summaryZh: 在你的睡眠周期结束时醒来
products.descriptionZh: AirAlarm将你的iPhone和AirPods变成更温和的睡眠闹钟。设定唤醒时间窗口，伴随内置声音或你自己的媒体入睡，在90分钟周期结束时醒来。无需Apple Watch、账户、广告、分析或云端睡眠档案。
products.description: AirAlarm turns your iPhone and AirPods into a gentler sleep alarm. Set a wake window, drift off with built-in sounds or your own media, and wake at the end of a 90-minute cycle. No Apple Watch, account, ads, analytics, or cloud sleep profile.
